items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: this is Jacques Pepiton, who is the president and business agent of the local musician's union. He gets on. I got evening a ladies and a gentleman.

ctx.x: You know, musicians. This is Pepiton.

The dedication of WWL when they went 50,000 watts. They had the mayor of the city and they had this guy and this guy and this guy and this guy. And from Loyola University and now, this is Jacques Pepiton, who is the president and business agent of the local musician's union. He gets on. I got evening a ladies and a gentleman. He says, it's a great pleasure to be here with you folks tonight. He said, and I want to wish you WWL a lot of luck because they need it. He said, now, WWL is a good station because they…
You mentioned that before. Toe KT, that was out of Spanish Fort.
